body: Update runLiveHookRunnerSecurityBenchmark Check 1 in evals/v13-enhancements-bench.mjs so staged hook-runner PASSWD_HOME anchoring is verified without relying on a PATH getent shim (using bwrap --ro-bind /etc/passwd on Linux and sandbox-exec ~/.gemini write-denial on macOS, falling back to real OS account home verification only inside an isolated sandbox).
title: Update evals hook-runner PASSWD_HOME check to use kernel bwrap /etc/passwd and Seatbelt instead of PATH getent shim
